_meta.transcription: VERBATIM. Every service name, length tier, figure and membership benefit below is exactly as printed on the price list PDF, in the printed order. Nothing added, nothing removed, nothing renamed, nothing rounded.
_meta.authority: This file is the ONLY source of pricing for the website. Do not take prices from the Brand Kit PDF and do not type a price by hand anywhere in the codebase. Where the Brand Kit disagrees, this file wins.

hair_styling.note: The PDF prints all seven services as one table under a single HAIR STYLING heading. Keep them as one dataset. You may group them visually on screen, but do not split them into separate categories in the data.

services.includes_display_en: braid / scalp massage / liquid glass / moisture

services.render_rule: Both are product names. Render as plain text with no themed treatment, no props, no set dressing and no caption built around them. Brand Kit page 10 states that several Drybar style names come from cocktails, that the trademarked names stay as they are, and that nothing may be built around alcohol or bar imagery in the Qatar market.

membership.extras_placement_note: On the PDF the complimentary hair treatment is printed with a plus sign directly beneath the 8 session block, so it reads as belonging to that tier. It is attached to m8 here. If the client says it applies to all three tiers, move it, but do not change any percentage or session count.
membership.copy_rule: The word session is on the Brand Kit's AVOID list for describing a visit. It is unavoidable here because it is the membership's own unit of measure as printed. Use it inside membership copy only and nowhere else on the site.

girlieClub.provenance: Transcribed verbatim from client-supplied Girlie Club graphic on 2026-08-10. No figure, tier, or benefit may be altered without written client confirmation.
girlieClub.tagline_en: Great hair. Less time. Every time.

perks.body_en: On all Drybar products in shop.
Unused blowout rolls over to the next month while membership stays active.
A little treat from us on your membership anniversary.

not_in_source.note: The client brief asks for the four items below. None of them appear on the price list PDF, so there is no figure to publish. Build the shells, leave them empty, invent nothing.

durations.detail: The price list carries no service durations. The only timing figure printed anywhere on it is the extensions note, adds 15 mins to each service, which is already captured above. Do not render a duration column on the price table. Ask the client for the Zenoti service catalogue export, which stores duration per service, then add the column in a later pass.

home_services.detail: No home service, travel fee, minimum spend, coverage area or lead time exists in any source. Section shell behind a feature flag, default off.

gift_cards.detail: No denominations, validity or terms exist in any source. Before designing a purchase flow, confirm whether Zenoti issues and redeems gift cards for this account. If it does, this is an outbound link and not a page to build.

membership_terms.detail: The PDF gives session counts and discounts only. Validity, up front cost, transferability, whether add-ons count toward a session, which session the discount applies to, and expiry are all absent. Render the tiers exactly as printed and leave the terms block empty with a TODO_TERMS marker.

brand_kit_divergences_for_the_record.note: Not action items. Recorded once so nobody 'corrects' the price data later by reaching for the Brand Kit. In every case below the price list above is what ships.
items: Brand Kit page 05 lists a cheapest blowout of 257 and mandates the phrase 'from QAR 257'. The price list says 250, so the site says 'from QAR 250'.
Brand Kit page 05 knows only two length bands. The price list has four, including Extra Long.
Brand Kit page 05 prices Uptini flat at 425 and Half Uptini flat at 275. The price list scales both by length.
Brand Kit page 05 lists a children's service, Shirley Temple, at 181. It is not on the price list, so it does not appear on the site.

Brand Kit page 04 states that price follows hair length and time rather than the finish chosen. The price list prices each finish differently, so that sentence is not used as website copy. The site says price follows hair length and the style chosen, which is what the price list actually shows.
Brand Kit spells the second premium add-on 'Cure Liqur'. The price list spells it 'Cure Liquor'. The price list spelling ships.

Brand Kit page 05 tells partners not to publish memberships. That instruction is addressed to creators and media partners, not to the brand's own website, and this is the brand's own price list being published on the brand's own site. The tiers ship as printed.
